teaching.title: Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Graded programming exercises on variables, conditionals, lists and arrays using an instructor-provided rubric.
Prepared worked examples covering these programming topics for review by the course instructor.

projects.title: Recipe Organiser
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven recipe organiser in Python using functions and collections for an individual course project.
Documented how recipe records are added, searched and updated within the menu-driven program.

projects.title: Quiz Practice Interface
bullets: Built a local quiz practice browser interface with form inputs using JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Implemented event handling and input validation, and tested keyboard interaction and alternate input cases.
